cards.title: pvcVPC and Variability Correction
cards.claim: Prediction- and variability-corrected VPCs (pvcVPC) further normalize the dependent variable by the typical variability (standard deviation) of the prediction-corrected values, accounting for non-constant relative variability across bins.
conditions: Expected relative variability differs between observations within a bin due to parameter dependencies or non-proportional residual error models.
Used when pcVPC alone is insufficient to account for heteroscedasticity in the corrected data.
required_inputs: Standard deviation of simulated pcY values.
Median standard deviation of pcY for the specific bin.
limitations: In the examples investigated, pvcVPCs showed only marginal diagnostic advantage over pcVPCs, possibly due to similar expected variability within bins.
Adds complexity to the diagnostic plot interpretation.
cards.downstream_use: Advanced model diagnostics where residual error structure or parameter-specific variability contributions need to be explicitly normalized to isolate structural model misspecification.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
